title: Khan Academy SAT Session Score Delta Leaderboard
dataSources: Canvas assignments (`canvas:assignment`), Khan Academy SAT practice (`khan:sat`), Family Link usage (`familylink:usage`), and OurHome chores (`ourhome:chore`).
app: Canvas LMS exports, Khan Academy SAT practice, Google Family Link screen-time data, and OurHome chore tracking streamed to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=khan:sat score_delta=*
| stats sum(score_delta) as total_value, avg(score_delta) as avg_value by skill_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks skill name values by total and average score delta across Khan Academy SAT session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `score_delta` values for each Khan Academy SAT session event and review total and average score delta by skill name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total score delta.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which skill name shows the biggest score delta numbers in your Khan Academy SAT session data.
